data.name: Impossible Travel — Concurrent Geo Sessions
data.description: A single identity authenticated from two geographies faster than physical travel allows.
data.response: Force re-authentication, revoke active sessions, verify with the account owner.

data.name: Credential Stuffing Burst
data.description: High-volume authentication failures across many accounts from a small set of source IPs.
data.response: Block source ranges at the edge, enable step-up MFA, check for successful logins.

data.name: Ransomware Canary File Modified
data.description: Decoy canary files were renamed or encrypted — a strong pre-encryption ransomware signal.
data.response: Isolate host immediately, snapshot volumes, hunt for the parent process tree.

data.name: Suspicious PowerShell — Encoded Command
data.description: PowerShell launched with -EncodedCommand and hidden window from a non-admin parent.
data.response: Decode the payload, quarantine the binary, check outbound connections from the host.

data.name: Beaconing to Rare External Destination
data.description: Low-jitter periodic callbacks to a domain seen nowhere else in the estate.
data.response: Sinkhole the domain, capture full PCAP, image the beaconing host.

data.name: Cloud IAM Privilege Escalation
data.description: A non-admin principal attached an administrator policy to itself.
data.response: Detach the policy, rotate the access key, review CloudTrail for the full session.

data.name: Mass Data Egress to Personal Storage
data.description: Volume of uploads to an unmanaged cloud storage provider exceeded baseline by 40x.
data.response: Block the destination, preserve the file list, engage HR and Legal if intentional.

data.name: Kerberoasting — Bulk SPN Ticket Requests
data.description: A single account requested service tickets for an unusual number of SPNs (RC4 encryption).
data.response: Reset affected service account passwords, enforce AES, hunt for offline cracking.

data.name: Public S3 Bucket Exposure
data.description: A storage bucket containing classified objects was made publicly readable.
data.response: Revoke the public ACL, review access logs for anonymous reads, notify the data owner.

data.name: Web Shell Dropped in Web Root
data.description: A new executable script appeared in a public web directory outside the deploy pipeline.
data.response: Take the node out of the load balancer, preserve the file, review access logs.

data.name: Phishing Link Clicked — Credential Harvest Page
data.description: A user followed a link to a newly registered domain impersonating the corporate SSO page.
data.response: Reset the user password, purge the message tenant-wide, block the domain.

data.name: Lateral Movement — SMB Admin Share Access
data.description: A workstation account authenticated to ADMIN$ on multiple servers in under a minute.
data.response: Isolate the source host, disable the account, hunt for the credential source.

data.name: Security Tooling Disabled on Endpoint
data.description: Real-time protection was turned off by a process that is not the management agent.
data.response: Re-enable protection, treat the host as compromised, collect a memory image.

data.name: Anomalous Database Query Volume
data.description: A service account executed full-table SELECTs far outside its normal query profile.
data.response: Review the query text, confirm with the owning team, check for a compromised secret.

data.name: New Domain Admin Account Created
data.description: A privileged account was created outside the change window and the IAM workflow.
data.response: Disable the account, identify the creating session, run a full AD integrity check.

data.name: Outdated TLS / Weak Cipher Negotiated
data.description: An internal service accepted a TLS 1.0 handshake with an export-grade cipher suite.
data.response: Update the TLS policy on the listener, rescan, add to the hardening backlog.

data.name: Container Escape Attempt Detected
data.description: A container process attempted to mount the host filesystem via a privileged syscall.
data.response: Kill the pod, cordon the node, review the admission policy that allowed privilege.

data.name: DNS Tunnelling Pattern
data.description: High-entropy subdomain queries to a single authoritative name server at a fixed cadence.
data.response: Block the parent domain, decode sample queries, isolate the querying host.

data.name: Brute Force — SSH Public Endpoint
data.description: Sustained failed SSH authentications against an internet-facing bastion host.
data.response: Confirm key-only auth, rate-limit the source, verify no successful login followed.

data.name: Scheduled Task Persistence Created
data.description: A task was registered to run a binary from a user-writable temp directory at logon.
data.response: Remove the task, hash the binary, check the estate for the same artefact.

data.title: Cloud IAM privilege escalation by CI service principal
data.summary: The svc-deploy-ci principal attached AdministratorAccess to itself outside a change window. Suspected leaked access key in a public repository.

timeline.entry: CloudTrail alert on AttachUserPolicy for an administrator policy.
Policy detached and the access key disabled within 9 minutes.
Secret scanning confirmed the key was committed to a public repository 40 hours earlier.
Full session replay from CloudTrail is under review.

data.title: Public exposure of customer export storage bucket
data.summary: s3-customer-exports was made publicly readable by a Terraform change. Access logs are being reviewed for anonymous reads during the exposure window.

timeline.entry: CSPM detected a public-read ACL on a bucket holding classified objects.
Public access revoked and account-level block enabled.
Exposure window measured at 71 minutes.
Access log review for anonymous reads is in progress.

data.title: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing campaign against finance team
data.summary: Fourteen users received a link to auth-gateway-secure.app, an AiTM proxy relaying live session cookies. Three users clicked; one submitted credentials plus a TOTP code.
data.rule: Phishing Link Clicked — Credential Harvest Page

timeline.entry: Email gateway flagged a newly registered lookalike domain.
Click telemetry identified three users who followed the link.
Affected sessions revoked and passwords reset.
Tenant-wide purge removed the message from all mailboxes.
Hunting for post-authentication activity on the affected identity is ongoing.

data.title: Credential stuffing against the customer portal
data.summary: 61,400 authentication attempts from 340 residential proxy IPs over 22 minutes. Nine accounts matched breached credentials; all were force-reset before use.

timeline.entry: WAF rate anomaly triggered on the login endpoint.
Source ranges blocked at the edge and step-up MFA enforced.
Nine at-risk accounts identified and force-reset.
No successful unauthorised session was established.

data.title: Ransomware staging detected on finance database host
data.summary: Canary files on sql-fin-prod were renamed by a process spawned from a scheduled task. Host isolated within 4 minutes of detection; no encryption of production volumes occurred.

timeline.entry: Canary file modification detected by EDR sensor.
Automated containment isolated the host from the network.
Analyst confirmed the parent process chain originated from a Kerberoasted service account.
Service account credentials rotated across the estate.
Memory image captured and shipped to forensics.
Host rebuilt from a known-good gold image and returned to service.

data.title: Impossible travel on privileged administrator account
data.summary: admin.break-glass authenticated from two continents 11 minutes apart. Confirmed as a corporate VPN egress change, not a compromise.

timeline.entry: Identity provider correlation raised an impossible-travel alert.
Sessions revoked pending verification.
Account owner confirmed activity by an out-of-band channel.
Geo-baseline updated for the new VPN egress range; closed as a false positive.

data.title: DNS tunnelling from research subnet workstation
data.summary: High-entropy subdomain queries to dns.telemetry-node.io at a fixed 30-second cadence. Traced to an unapproved developer tool, not adversary activity.

timeline.entry: Resolver logs flagged an anomalous query-entropy pattern.
Host isolated as a precaution and PCAP captured.
Decoded queries resolved to a vendor telemetry beacon in an unsanctioned SDK.
Closed as a true-positive detection with benign root cause; SDK added to the software blocklist.

data.title: Web shell dropped on DMZ web node
data.summary: A PHP script appeared in the web root of web-edge-01 outside the deployment pipeline, following exploitation of CVE-2026-1774.
data.rule: Web Shell Dropped in Web Root

timeline.entry: File integrity monitoring detected an unsigned script in the web root.
Node removed from the load balancer pool.
Access logs confirmed exploitation of the Tomcat deserialisation flaw.
Patch deployed fleet-wide and the node rebuilt.
Post-incident review completed; WAF virtual patch added.

data.title: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing campaign against finance team
data.summary: Fourteen users received a link to auth-gateway-secure.app, an AiTM proxy relaying live session cookies. Three users clicked; one submitted credentials plus a TOTP code.
data.rule: Phishing Link Clicked — Credential Harvest Page

Affected sessions revoked and passwords reset.
Tenant-wide purge removed the message from all mailboxes.
Hunting for post-authentication activity on the affected identity is ongoing.

data.title: Credential stuffing against the customer portal
data.summary: 61,400 authentication attempts from 340 residential proxy IPs over 22 minutes. Nine accounts matched breached credentials; all were force-reset before use.

timeline.entry: WAF rate anomaly triggered on the login endpoint.
Source ranges blocked at the edge and step-up MFA enforced.
Nine at-risk accounts identified and force-reset.
No successful unauthorised session was established.

data.title: Ransomware staging detected on finance database host
data.summary: Canary files on sql-fin-prod were renamed by a process spawned from a scheduled task. Host isolated within 4 minutes of detection; no encryption of production volumes occurred.

timeline.entry: Canary file modification detected by EDR sensor.
Automated containment isolated the host from the network.
Analyst confirmed the parent process chain originated from a Kerberoasted service account.
Service account credentials rotated across the estate.
Memory image captured and shipped to forensics.
Host rebuilt from a known-good gold image and returned to service.

data.title: Impossible travel on privileged administrator account
data.summary: admin.break-glass authenticated from two continents 11 minutes apart. Confirmed as a corporate VPN egress change, not a compromise.

timeline.entry: Identity provider correlation raised an impossible-travel alert.
Sessions revoked pending verification.
Account owner confirmed activity by an out-of-band channel.
Geo-baseline updated for the new VPN egress range; closed as a false positive.

data.title: DNS tunnelling from research subnet workstation
data.summary: High-entropy subdomain queries to dns.telemetry-node.io at a fixed 30-second cadence. Traced to an unapproved developer tool, not adversary activity.

timeline.entry: Resolver logs flagged an anomalous query-entropy pattern.
Host isolated as a precaution and PCAP captured.
Decoded queries resolved to a vendor telemetry beacon in an unsanctioned SDK.
Closed as a true-positive detection with benign root cause; SDK added to the software blocklist.

Patch deployed fleet-wide and the node rebuilt.
Post-incident review completed; WAF virtual patch added.

data.title: Cloud IAM privilege escalation by CI service principal
data.summary: The svc-deploy-ci principal attached AdministratorAccess to itself outside a change window. Suspected leaked access key in a public repository.

timeline.entry: CloudTrail alert on AttachUserPolicy for an administrator policy.
Policy detached and the access key disabled within 9 minutes.
Secret scanning confirmed the key was committed to a public repository 40 hours earlier.
Full session replay from CloudTrail is under review.

data.title: Public exposure of customer export storage bucket
data.summary: s3-customer-exports was made publicly readable by a Terraform change. Access logs are being reviewed for anonymous reads during the exposure window.

timeline.entry: CSPM detected a public-read ACL on a bucket holding classified objects.
Public access revoked and account-level block enabled.
Exposure window measured at 71 minutes.
Access log review for anonymous reads is in progress.

data.title: Adversary-in-the-middle phishing campaign against finance team
data.summary: Fourteen users received a link to auth-gateway-secure.app, an AiTM proxy relaying live session cookies. Three users clicked; one submitted credentials plus a TOTP code.
data.rule: Phishing Link Clicked — Credential Harvest Page

timeline.entry: Email gateway flagged a newly registered lookalike domain.
Click telemetry identified three users who followed the link.
Affected sessions revoked and passwords reset.
Tenant-wide purge removed the message from all mailboxes.
Hunting for post-authentication activity on the affected identity is ongoing.

data.title: Credential stuffing against the customer portal
data.summary: 61,400 authentication attempts from 340 residential proxy IPs over 22 minutes. Nine accounts matched breached credentials; all were force-reset before use.

timeline.entry: WAF rate anomaly triggered on the login endpoint.
Source ranges blocked at the edge and step-up MFA enforced.
Nine at-risk accounts identified and force-reset.
No successful unauthorised session was established.

data.title: Ransomware staging detected on finance database host
data.summary: Canary files on sql-fin-prod were renamed by a process spawned from a scheduled task. Host isolated within 4 minutes of detection; no encryption of production volumes occurred.

timeline.entry: Canary file modification detected by EDR sensor.
Automated containment isolated the host from the network.
Analyst confirmed the parent process chain originated from a Kerberoasted service account.
Service account credentials rotated across the estate.
Memory image captured and shipped to forensics.
Host rebuilt from a known-good gold image and returned to service.

data.title: Impossible travel on privileged administrator account
data.summary: admin.break-glass authenticated from two continents 11 minutes apart. Confirmed as a corporate VPN egress change, not a compromise.

timeline.entry: Identity provider correlation raised an impossible-travel alert.
Sessions revoked pending verification.
Account owner confirmed activity by an out-of-band channel.
Geo-baseline updated for the new VPN egress range; closed as a false positive.

data.title: DNS tunnelling from research subnet workstation
data.summary: High-entropy subdomain queries to dns.telemetry-node.io at a fixed 30-second cadence. Traced to an unapproved developer tool, not adversary activity.

timeline.entry: Resolver logs flagged an anomalous query-entropy pattern.
Host isolated as a precaution and PCAP captured.
Decoded queries resolved to a vendor telemetry beacon in an unsanctioned SDK.
Closed as a true-positive detection with benign root cause; SDK added to the software blocklist.

data.title: Web shell dropped on DMZ web node
data.summary: A PHP script appeared in the web root of web-edge-01 outside the deployment pipeline, following exploitation of CVE-2026-1774.
data.rule: Web Shell Dropped in Web Root

timeline.entry: File integrity monitoring detected an unsigned script in the web root.
Node removed from the load balancer pool.
Access logs confirmed exploitation of the Tomcat deserialisation flaw.
Patch deployed fleet-wide and the node rebuilt.
